authorized_scope: Exact 170044 original CSV Non-People paths. Historical 168748 pending paths and 66077 review obligations plus two previously delivered paths requiring fresh current-version review. Effective 168750 pending paths and 66079 source reviews.
authorization: User authorized blob-and-thin-remnant source screen, unchanged skipped originals, current cleanup and independent checking of every changed output.
source_review: Qualified source review using the unchanged components_ge64_at_512 catalogue and existing selected-mask workflow; every available component remains selectable regardless of source-screen qualifying groups. Fresh review of all five historical retained originals.
source_comparison: Different actual poses or subjects may share names. Single-style concepts remain in scope.
cleanup: Only reviewed strict-white core alpha becomes zero. Every RGB value and every other RGBA value stays exact.
output_review: Independent of source reviewer; every changed full image, every region and normal-size usefulness; identity/hash-bound record immediately after viewing.
acceptance: Only mechanically verified outputs with clear visual safety and clear worthwhile improvement. Otherwise retain original.
prior_work: Apply the seven approved historical resolutions before the exact three current-source revisions. Require fresh source review for all three revisions and independent review of every changed candidate. Historical trial outputs and stale cleaned deliveries are excluded from completion.

storage.temporary_previews: bounded to active batches; remove after verified QA

reviewer_requirement: Qualified source and independent output reviewers; uncertain regions remain unchanged; no user approval required per batch.
grouping_scope: Exact original Non-People Library topic and subfolder plus normalized filename stem, independently classified by original CSV collection provenance.

source_screen.all_components_available_during_review: Every component available in the existing >=64 catalogue, regardless of screen-passing blob group; no sub64 expansion.

execution_control: Default disabled. Effective execution requires both current People completion proofs/catalogs, the exact current pending-source byte proof, and root code and activation approvals.
